name: smart-model-router
description: Smart Model Router: picks the Claude model and effort for each turn and subagent

defaultMode.title: Routing mode
defaultMode.description: shadow records recommendations only; auto applies them; off disables the router

privacyMode.title: Privacy mode
privacyMode.description: local-only never sends the prompt to a classifier; cloud-ai or hybrid allow the AI classifier

aiClassifier.title: AI classifier
aiClassifier.description: on: unclear prompts are classified by Haiku on this session's access (needs privacy cloud-ai or hybrid)

liveMessages.title: Live routing messages
liveMessages.description: on: a line in the transcript and the band above the prompt when a turn is routed; band: the band only; off: none

daemonUrl.title: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: Where decisions are recorded (mr start); loopback only

daemonToken.title: Daemon token
daemonToken.description: Printed by mr init; without it decisions stay buffered in the mod
